title: Sign up and reach the dashboard
description: A new user can complete registration and land on the authenticated dashboard workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /signup
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the registration form
Verify the dashboard is displayed
Verify the authenticated workspace is visible

title: Log in and reach the dashboard
description: An existing user can log in successfully and land on the authenticated dashboard workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the dashboard is displayed
Verify the authenticated workspace is visible

title: Create a league division and configure its settings
description: A league organizer can add a division, adjust its fee or rules override, and see the division appear in the league workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /leagues
Open the Division Architect tab
Add a division and enter its name
Adjust the division fee or rules override
Verify the new division is listed
Verify the division settings are available

title: Assign league teams and generate a division schedule
description: A league organizer can assign teams to divisions, generate a schedule, and see the schedule and standings reflected for the division.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /leagues
Open the Division Architect tab
Add a division and enter its name
Assign teams to divisions in the teams list
Generate the schedule
Verify the division-filtered schedule is displayed
Verify the division-filtered standings are displayed

title: Create tournament divisions and assign teams in the roster
description: A tournament organizer can add divisions in Architecture and assign each team to a division in the Roster tab.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /manage-tournaments
Open the Architecture tab
Add divisions and enter their names
Switch to the Roster tab
Select a division for each team
Verify the updated division organization is displayed
Verify the assigned teams are listed under their divisions

title: Filter league schedule and standings by division
description: A league organizer can use division filters to narrow schedule and standings results to one division.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /leagues
Open the Division Architect tab
Add multiple divisions and enter their names
Assign teams to different divisions in the teams list
Use a division filter chip to narrow the schedule and standings
Verify the filtered schedule results are displayed
Verify the filtered standings results are displayed

title: Filter tournament itinerary and review division standings

Switch to the Roster tab

Verify the division-specific standings are displayed
